observations.statement: 86 committed receipts are available: 82 successful executions and four trace-v1 failures. All observed training uses declared seed42; dependent replays/source versions are not independent initializations.

Feature-only, pooled-history and target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861. History is useful under the frozen benchmark; this alone identifies no semantic mechanism.

Latest crossed-half beats crossed-full by +0.0004667050401 AUC and -0.0003271451568 unweighted Logloss, at equal 17,130,275 parameters and the same frozen data/pass recipe. Both jobs succeeded and have null errors.

Crossed-half remains below the aligned no-row anchor by -0.0012437529830 AUC and +0.0001256945697 Logloss. It improves the original target-aware reference, but that accumulated comparison does not isolate the half rule.

Crossed-full exactly replays historical crossed-unit AUC, Logloss, sample count and all23 slice records. Aligned observer-free half likewise replays r0012-scale_half aggregates/slices. These are aggregate bridges across distinct sources, not proof of identical tensors or optimizer paths.

Crossed-half improves AUC in20 of23 inherited overlapping slices and lowers loss in23 of23. AUC declines in empty_history (-0.0027467163), past_pv_absent (-0.0006457021), and user_train_frequency_100_4294967296 (-0.0001152764). Uniform ranking benefit is contradicted.

Schema8 candidate-authored diagnostics report zero same-checkpoint full/half product and active-logit discrepancies, finite logits, zero masked mass and empty summaries. All60475 sampled valid events are eligible, with no floor or boundary events; only512 impressions and four empty histories are covered.

The candidate diagnostics report nontrivial mean absolute own/donor scale changes (0.0720041 full-checkpoint and0.0715050 half-checkpoint), first/second scale-moment relative errors below2.22e-7, zero synthetic donor error and synthetic VJP relative errors1.44e-16. These bounded measurements are consistent with the declared intervention but do not measure training-wide optimizer effects.

Latest half records +5.4108 wall seconds and +5.0110 training seconds versus full, with peak GPU memory902733312 versus900373504 bytes. Inference is175765 versus176687 examples/s; batch4096 p50/p95 latency is21.784/22.473 versus21.551/22.242ms, including causal feature gathering. No efficiency superiority follows from this one pair.

Magnitude historical maximum AUC0.6152795937 is retained. Its same-source exact17 replay gives0.6149279139; round26 magnitude gains0.0000243281 versus N, whereas round27 loses0.0001685359. A repeatable magnitude increment is unestablished.

Latest knowledge usage is documented; both executed variant names, source hashes and success statuses agree with committed receipts, with no undocumented industry IDs. This is provenance, not an estimate of knowledge value.
